name: Reno Winter 2018

venue.name: University of Nevada, Reno
venue.address: Mathewson-IGT Knowledge Center, 1664 N Virginia St Reno, NV 89512
venue.details: Rotunda of the Mathewson-IGT Knowledge Center.

information:
**THIS COMPETITION IS IN A DIFFERENT LOCATION THAN NORMAL!**
The Rotunda is the big circular room on the entry-level floor of the Knowledge Center. **Same building** as previous competitions, but **new spot** in it.

Registration fees for UNR/Davidson Academy students, staff, and faculty are at a reduced price of $10. All registration payments are to be made in cash on the day of the competition. There will be a competitor limit of 50.
